rationale: Both Shawn and Archie are building in robotics with complementary expertise—Shawn's robotics-manipulation focus at Addition Robotics and Archie's full-stack approach to autonomous drone systems and swarm autonomy at Hyperic. As judges at this event, they can share perspectives on robotics hardware, autonomy challenges, and manufacturing scalability, areas where their domain knowledge overlaps meaningfully.
intro_message: Shawn, meet Archie Shou—he's building fully autonomous drones and swarm systems at Hyperic with a robotics and embedded systems background, and you're both deep in robotics problem-solving.
